title.zh: 【XRP Ledger 漏洞修复补丁因验证器支持率下降而推迟至 11 月生效】
title.en: 【XRP Ledger 漏洞修复补丁因验证器支持率下降而推迟至 11 月生效】

current_state.zh: The XRP Ledger's security fix for a token-creation vulnerability and lending-loan logic flaw was pushed to Nov 4 after validator support briefly fell to 26 of 35, resetting the two-week activation countdown; support has since recovered to 31.
current_state.en: The XRP Ledger's security fix for a token-creation vulnerability and lending-loan logic flaw was pushed to Nov 4 after validator support briefly fell to 26 of 35, resetting the two-week activation countdown; support has since recovered to 31.
